 India suffer second straight defeat in Hong Kong Sixes
 UAE made the chase look incredibly easy. They reached the target in just 4.2 overs without losing a single wicket.
 Written by : Khan Mutasim Billah Life 
 Posted - Oct 31, 2026, 10:14 am 2026-10-31T10:14:01+06:00 
 Updated - Oct 31, 2026, 10:14 am 2026-10-31T10:14:01+06:00 
 India suffered another defeat in the Hong Kong Sixes as they lost to the United Arab Emirates after their earlier loss to Pakistan . Meanwhile, UAE enjoyed a memorable campaign in Group C as they beat both India and Pakistan.
 Batting first in Mong Kok, India were bowled out for just 94 on the final ball of their innings. T Natarajan was their top scorer with 38 off 14 balls. Rahul Tripathi also made a quick contribution, scoring 24 off just seven deliveries.
 Zahid Ali was the pick of the UAE bowlers, taking three wickets.
 Get Latest Cricket Updates on WhatsApp UAE made the chase look incredibly easy. They reached the target in just 4.2 overs without losing a single wicket.
 Khalid Shah led the charge with an unbeaten 52 off 14 balls, smashing three fours and six sixes. His opening partner, Ansh Tandon, also remained unbeaten, scoring 39 off 12 deliveries with two fours and five sixes.
 Follow google news channel to get news of BDCricTime. Krunal Pandya had a difficult outing with the ball, conceding two sixes in the only two deliveries he bowled. He had also been expensive in the previous match.
